'''Rowan Delk''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who lived on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].

==Biography==
In [[3643 BBY]], Rowan assisted in guiding [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Eriz Vossan]] through the desert. Rowan saw how noble and bright he was as a Jedi Master, but when he suffered from a terrible plague that [[Sith Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Parkanas Tark|Vivicar]] formed, he became insane which displeased Rowan until he got himself sick. Despite his illness, Rowan Delk met with a [[The Barsen'thor|Jedi Consular]] who was here to search for Master Vossan. He suggested in meeting at a settlement named Malcolm's Dunes in the [[Dune Sea/Legends|Dune Sea]] of the desert planet. After meeting at the settlement, he and the [[Jedi Consular|Consular]] found a message from Master Vossan, in which he claimed to be searching for the ultimate [[Species/Legends|species]] of warriors after seeing a vision. Rowan was present with the Jedi Consular when he shielded Master Vossan from the illness, curing him.
